programme.title: 老闆娘 / Queen of Triads 2
programme.desc: 上世紀70年代的舊香港，處於英國殖民統治下的黑暗時代，警方與黑社會勾結，窮人深受其害。在貧民區的“鐵記飯店”老闆娘鐵姐，帶領手下員工對抗惡勢力，保護被欺壓的老百姓。他們聯合正義的公民合力打擊黑幫，並與收受賄賂的警員鬥智鬥勇，最終還老百姓一個和平與安寧。

programme.title: 白門五甲 / The Mystical Treasure
programme.desc: 葛振為了拯救車遲國，加入了殺手組織都司府，成為十二暗軍的預備役，專門執行朝廷的秘密任務。葛振在師傅那裡學到白門五甲絕技，在查案時邂逅秋葵，兩人互生情愫。與此同時十二暗軍中最強的午馬被神秘人殺死，最終葛振與秋葵能否在一起？他又可否拯救國家？

programme.title: 生死排爆 / Men of Sacrifice
programme.desc: 在南方一座城市中突發一起爆炸危機事件，排爆特警在第一時間展開迅速救援和週密偵破。為排除其他爆炸隱患，守護群眾安全，特警馬進和朱江等人衝鋒在前，不斷化解炸彈危機。排爆隊員在全城展開排爆行動與犯罪分子之間的較量一觸即發，勝負只在毫秒間。

programme.title: 陰陽鎮怪談 / The Town of Ghosts
programme.desc: 民國年間，陰陽鎮遭恐怖詛咒，傳說進去後誰也出不去，離開的人都會神秘死亡。尋寶人閻陽一和寶葫蘆誤入了陰陽鎮，雖然閻不相信傳說，但他在鎮上卻常常遇到可怕的事情。然而讓閻和寶更沒想到的是，在詛咒之下的詭異小鎮，背後竟然隱藏驚人秘密!

programme.title: 破神錄 / As God
programme.desc: 在辛亥革命軍閥混戰的民國時期，用幻術蠱惑人心的教派林立，以無量老祖為首的教派常用幻術騙局荼毒百姓。這時大家閨秀孫瑾、人狼鏢師黎叔文、及徵戰沙場多年的功夫奇才楊烈鈞，三人一起誓要揭露所有幻術的真相。但他們及後發現楊與黎各自背後都隱藏著驚天秘密，究竟誰忠誰姦？

programme.title: 上海灘之風雲正道 / The King of Shanghai Beach
programme.desc: 民國時期，上海商會會長鄭有道掌管著上海重要的貨運碼頭，成為了日本人跟各方勢力拉攏的目標人物。然而，他阻止販賣及輸入鴉片，因此影響到各方勢力的利益，並引起了多次幫派大戰。最終鄭在愛國隊員蘇婉婷的感召下，明白了保家衛國才是人生該走的正道！

programme.title: 新洗冤錄 / Song Ci
programme.desc: 大宋淳佑七年，欽州靈龍鎮災患頻現，民間謠言乃蛟龍作祟，需將童男童女投入鎖龍井餵食蛟龍方能得享安寧，無數鎮民的子孫被投入井中。新科進士莊嚴擔任主簿後，執意要進入鎖龍井調查，卻因為誣捏他得罪龍王而被囚禁入獄。小宛為救莊嚴，千裡迢迢請了宋慈到靈龍鎮查明真相。

programme.title: 老闆娘2無間潛行 / Queen of Triads
programme.desc: 上世紀七十年代，香港在英國殖民統治下貪腐嚴重，黑惡勢力橫行，毒梟坤哥及豪哥大賺不義之財。廉政公署人員白玫瑰奉命潛伏到黑幫大佬豪哥身邊收集罪證。玫瑰與豪哥日漸熟識，兩人互生情愫。面對一面是將毒梟繩之以法，一面是與豪哥愛慕的緣分，玫瑰究竟該何去何從？

programme.title: 陰陽跨界人 / Yin Yang Kua Jie Ren
programme.desc: 少年閻晃跟著身為撈屍人的師父老姜，在天水村遇到離奇事件，傳聞二十年前有水怪禍亂屠戮村莊，現在怨靈回魂伺機索命，流言四起。在調查期間，閻在林瑤及老姜等人的幫助下堅定立場，不被封建迷信所蒙蔽，努力探尋真相。閻不僅找回了自己的身世，最終更捉拿真兇將其制裁。

programme.title: 青龍偃月刀 / Knights of Valour
programme.desc: 三國時期，一代名將關羽在麥城之戰被吳國將軍潘璋所殺，青龍偃月刀也被奪走。兩年後蜀國君主劉備親徵為關羽報仇，任命關羽之子關興組成小隊，秘密執行破壞吳軍水寨防禦中樞的任務。關興突破重重險阻，最終與殺父仇人潘璋在水寨中展開決戰，誓要奪回父親的青龍偃月刀。

programme.title: 大颱風 / Typhoon
programme.desc: 十年前，身為救援隊隊長的張一凡帶著家人去度假，不料突發遇到颱風，張的兒子也意外在山崩中喪生。兒子的死讓他變得神經質，妻子也提出離婚。張本想挽回家庭，不料又一場颱風來襲，妻子被颱風所困，女兒又被人綁架。面對這場天災人禍，張不得已在颱風中踏上解救妻女之路。

programme.title: 雙面狐 / Double-faced Fox
programme.desc: 魔族在雲盛皇朝興風作浪，皇帝突死於怪病，在臨終前將盛寧公主下嫁伏龍大將軍白奕。公主向太後請求悔婚遭拒絕，漸漸兩人相處後關係緩和，公主發現自已對白奕已芳心暗許。及後公主被魔族尾火虎挾持，白奕在混戰中救出公主但不幸犧牲。他們最終會是天人永隔，或是有機會再續前緣？

programme.title: 鬼手神槍 / The Sniper
programme.desc: 江城傳奇神槍手“鬼手”，被保護江城安寧的羲和堂以叛徒之名追捕。小混混陸瀾意外得知哥哥被鬼手所殺，為了復仇加入羲和堂，在女殺手冷楓的培養下成長為一名頂尖槍手。陸決意殺掉鬼手為兄報仇，在生死槍戰之際卻發現鬼手的真實身份，及識破了羲和堂的重大陰謀。

programme.title: 驅魔天師 / Exorcist
programme.desc: 捉妖師林天師的徒弟劉一澤，向心上人丁香提親之時，發現丁家被狐妖所控制。與狐妖鬥法後，劉誤以為狐妖已被師傅封印，不幸發現狐妖已附身在師傅身上。劉一方面要對付狐妖，另一方面又怕傷害師傅。他最終能否戰勝狐妖，保護眾人?

programme.title: 幽靈狙擊手 / Ghost Sniper
programme.desc: 雷霆安保公司的幽靈小隊，由林森帶領隊友執行解救女科學家南茜的任務。眾人救南後在撤離時見到一名小孩被關在籠裡，趕去營救，卻聽到槍響，之後全軍覆沒。於偉剛寫下小說“幽靈狙擊”的一段，跟著一聲槍響，被擊中頭部。當偉醒來時，卻發現自己變成了他筆下的林森!

programme.title: 仙劍風雲 / The Whirlwind of Sword and Fairy
programme.desc: 百年前，仙劍門祖師爺張掌門與異人首領幽皇大戰七天七夜，最終打敗幽皇，並將異人族兵器「九黎」封印。百年後，仙劍門弟子張之霖成為新掌門。此時發現鎮上女人離奇失蹤，原來是幽皇吸食女人精魄練就神功。仙劍門布下天罡北鬥陣迎戰，正邪大戰，一觸即發。

programme.title: 大蟲災 / Big Insect Disaster
programme.desc: 一列載著”淘金夢”開往上海的列車突然脫軌墜崖。吳天等一行人倖免於難，卻遭到蜈蚣攻擊。隨後他們逃進了一個怪異村莊，而古怪的村長對這幫各懷鬼胎的倖存者起了殺心。突然成群蜈蚣傾巢而出，在村中大開殺戒。吳天等人該如何逃離險境？古怪的村長到底隱藏著什麼秘密？

programme.title: 九門 / The Mystic Nine
programme.desc: 九門的陸尋與同僚大山受命保護兵部尚書鄭巖，但鄭突然離奇死亡。陸在調查中發現舞女封如月與其兄封空空可疑，但空空卻意外失蹤。陸循著線索，帶著大山、如月來到黑澤城，在執行公務的過程中無意被捲入驚天陰謀。陸在抽絲剝繭之下找到真兇，更揭開了寶藏謎團。

programme.title: 劍王朝之九境長生 / Sword Dynasty：Messy Inn
programme.desc: 在蘅王統治下民不聊生，有志之士誓要推翻蘅王，立下"衣帶詔"。蘅王請魏侯爺找出"衣帶詔"，並要派殺手殺死名單上所有人。白山水和謝柔均在名單上，而謝柔的弟弟謝長勝對白心生愛慕，與其他殺手一路追蹤白到客棧。在陰差陽錯的誤會中，長勝鬧出了一系列荒誕又爆笑的事情。

programme.title: 末世人間道 / Lost in Apocalypse
programme.desc: 茍勝、富貴等人突然在酒店遇到由食物引起的病毒爆發，感染者失去理智，瘋狂地撕咬其他人。茍勝帶領眾人逃離酒店，前往安全地方，在逃亡過程中與感染者發生了激烈搏鬥。隨後逃亡隊伍內部又突爆矛盾及衝突，互相猜忌。 眾人能否戰勝邪惡，懷著良知逃離險境？

programme.title: 封神：妲己 / The Queen
programme.desc: 狐族女君九尾不幸落入梅山七怪老大猿猴精袁洪之手，陰差陽錯被姜子牙所救，卻被姜斬斷一條尾巴。九尾走投無路在女媧娘娘的指點下附身在冀州候蘇護的女兒蘇妲己身上。不久，紂王攻打冀州，妲己被俘，及後紂王娶了妲己，使她成為了商朝皇後。然而天下大亂卻由此開始…

programme.title: 無罪之城 / The Innocent City
programme.desc: 太平洋的某處孤島上建立了一座沒有法律限製的「無罪之城」，眾多犯罪分子慕名前往，以求庇護。國際特種兵唐柯在無罪之城執行任務時不幸落入索蘭的圈套，逃生時發現自己體內被注射毒劑，生命只剩下幾小時。面對妻子被索蘭殺害，女兒也被綁架，孤注一擲的唐柯踏上復仇之路。

programme.title: 封神演義之斬仙飛刀 / Zhan Xian Fei Dao
programme.desc: 亂世末期，商朝遭到週武王的進攻，被週軍將領楊戩打得節節敗退。軍師申公豹向紂王建議招攬梅山七怪助商攻週，因為七怪之首袁洪與楊戩一樣精通八九玄功可七十二變。紂王命申公豹立刻前往梅山將七怪納入麾下。於是，楊戩率領的週軍與袁洪率領的商軍之間的戰鬥正式拉開帷幕!

programme.title: 私人英雄 / Private Hero
programme.desc: 在罪惡橫行的世界裡，有一個叫太平鎮的桃花源。這裡有私人英雄守護而未被黑幫入侵。吳正義為了成為私人英雄的一員，每天苦練功夫，在正義救星中心雄先生的幫助下成為私人英雄。隨後他發現該鎮被邪惡集團控制，最終與雄先生聯手，合力擊敗私人英雄首領。

programme.title: 奇門遁甲 / Fantasy Magician
programme.desc: 人族和妖族長年爭鬥，人族首領黃帝得"奇門遁甲"的力量終於平定世界，之後成立霧隱門來保護百姓。羅剎鎮捕頭週同因為被死對頭追殺，逃難途中隅遇生命垂危的霧隱門天老。關鍵時刻天老將體內武功傳給了週同，及後在霧隱門的幫助下，週同終於覺醒體內力量，擔起斬妖除魔的責任。

programme.title: 牧野詭事之觀山太保 / Guan Shan Tai Bao
programme.desc: 民國年間，觀山太保傳人封四九為了幫助籌募軍餉，答應鄭大帥嫡子鄭東西請求，尋找死在千季古地宮“九館”裡的遺體。鄭其實想找尋寶物，同時又找了發丘中郎一族後代陳青山一同參與。眾人幾番陷入兇險，幸好陳與封互相合作，齊心尋找寶物，用作軍餉幫助百姓。

programme.title: 故事販賣機 / Story Machine
programme.desc: 故事販賣機由四個獨立單元組成，包括《馴兔記》馴服小孩變成兔子的童話故事；《鬼打牆》男子來到酒店約會，卻誤入鬼打牆走不出去的懸疑故事；《官能許願》超能力男孩，以器官為代價，拯救意外慘死女友的愛情故事；及《雞湯泡麵》在城中售賣吃了能讓人開心的雞湯泡麵的奇幻故事。

programme.title: 浴血無名川 / Raid
programme.desc: 抗美援朝戰爭時期，志願軍三排排長孟大關臨危受命，帶領小隊前去解救被困敵後的偵察排。經歷了一系列艱難險阻，孟與由杜川帶領的偵察排終於成功匯合。為了避免部隊有更大傷亡，孟與杜在危急關頭果斷決定，要困死那個無法補充供給的敵方重炮營，為了保家衛國與敵人奮力戰鬥。

programme.title: 銅皮鐵骨方世玉 / Unbending Mr. Fang
programme.desc: 少林習武歸來的方世玉，本打算過平常人的生活，但剛回到家鄉肇慶便牽扯到一樁貪腐案中。朝廷貪官的爪牙鄂爾多帶隊殺人滅口並企圖銷毀證據，方世玉雖面對好友週蓉的慘死，母親被擒為人質，但卻面無懼色，決意反抗到底，與惡勢力殊死一戰。

programme.title: 龍雲鎮怪談 / Tales of Longyun Town
programme.desc: 民國初年的龍雲鎮，相傳鎮子發現寶藏後逐漸怪事不斷，接連出現少女家中被殺。同時，寶藏消息也招來各路心懷不軌的“江湖術士”紛紛前來尋寶。巡捕隊的林隊長迫於鎮長壓力，決定聯手死刑犯計連營一起找出真兇及解開背後陰謀，守衛龍雲鎮。。

programme.title: 窈窕老爹 / My Dad
programme.desc: 老實刻板的理髮師杜常勇喪妻後獨自撫養女兒。他想女兒能繼承自己的理髮店，但女兒一心只想參加新秀比賽節目當明星。二人缺乏理解加上代溝，引發父女之間頻繁爭吵。在一次爭吵後，杜到天台勸女兒回家，父女兩突然被宇宙射線擊中暈倒，當他們醒來後，發現兩人身體已經互換！

programme.title: 沙丘蟲暴 / Insect Disaster
programme.desc: 在地球未來，人類大量排放廢氣製造垃圾，使到地球迎來沙化期。動植物變異產生地球新主人“沙蟲”，而它們將人類逼到滅絕邊緣，倖存者只能尋找僅存的避難所“綠洲”。一支由富商、科學家、保安隊長、機械師以及混混組成的流亡小隊乘著特製裝甲車，踏上尋找“綠洲”的冒險旅程。

programme.title: 武狀元蘇乞兒之天降神諭 / King of the New Beggars
programme.desc: 清朝末期，西方列強在中國橫行霸道，百姓民不聊生。此時民間天降“神諭”，傳言大清要亡，加上顧命大臣接連暴斃，讓傳言更加沸騰。皇上任命九門提督富察·禦恆徹查此案，富察也請來好友蘇燦幫忙。燦發現刺客應該是用幻術殺人，而且手段殘忍，更意識到此事背後必有驚人秘密。

programme.title: 伏妖開封府之禦貓展昭 / Monster Hunt in Kaifeng
programme.desc: 北宋時期，宦官專權，邪靈橫行，汴梁境內興起了許多邪教，其中最大勢力是“外九流”。開封府裡的包拯、展昭和公孫策秘密審理邪靈案，然而“外九流”的人試圖毒害包拯，還籌劃著更龐大的陰謀。面對此情況，開封府眾人這次又如何應對？

programme.title: 金牌保鑣 / Gold Medal Protection
programme.desc: 雙腿殘疾的童松是矛盾安保公司的創始人，團隊中還有擅長機械的安寧和身手了得的大牛，公司主要是保護客戶安全，俗稱“保鏢”。這天，他們接到一個匿名委託，要保護的人正是安寧的妹妹安逸，之後逸便頻生意外。童發現背後可能有一個製造意外殺人的組織，究竟是誰要暗殺安逸？

programme.title: 風起洛陽之陰陽界 / Feng Qi Luo Yang
programme.desc: 武週時期，生活在洛陽洛河水兩端但不同出生的兩個少女意外被捲入懸案之中。一位是金吾衛隊長的女兒趙青青，另一位是生於市井底層的女孩小騙子。她們一同遭遇在洛陽城內一連串匪夷所思的離奇案件，二人組成了臨時搭檔，在亂世中維護正義，一起破解懸案。

programme.title: 特工狂花 / Miss Agent
programme.desc: 東南亞最大人口販賣組織頭目巴頌在自己的私人俱樂部設宴，邀請世界各地犯罪集團的頭目參加。雅美成功潛入俱樂部執行任務，為了掩護隊友撤退，美獨自引爆炸彈，與未婚夫方立一起裝死後隱居。三年後方立被綁架，迫雅美再執行任務，為救方立，美誓要將巴頌的犯罪組織一網打盡。

programme.title: 捉妖大仙2 / The Love of Immortal
programme.desc: 天意是天界出名的留級生，因前世孽緣未了無法成仙，後來一次意外他無意釋放了雪女令她越獄下凡，在捉拿雪女過程中，天意發現自己竟是害她淪為雪妖的人。為了彌補過錯，天意自願在陰間路上漂泊千年，一番磨難後，二人終於成婚，但天兵再次下凡捉拿雪女，他們能否如願一起呢?

programme.title: 一盤大棋 / Big Three Dragons
programme.desc: 老段多年前因涉嫌一樁案件入獄，而剛出獄的他為搞清當年真相，決定要謀劃一場大騙局。怎料此行動卻捲入了他與三個前妻所生的三個性格不同的孩子。一家四口一邊聯手抗敵，一邊互相搞破壞，而這一切都逐漸走向失控及不斷反轉的劇情，讓人永遠也猜不到結局會是怎樣。

programme.title: 不良師之大蛇災 / Special Police and Snake Revenge
programme.desc: 大唐盛世時期，曲江池天降妖龍異象，導致長安百姓一夜禿頭，令聖人勃然大怒。黃河縣令王玄秘密調查此案，發現背後竟有人密謀屠城計畫，影響到聖人安危。王玄深入偵查龍王教，過程中破解了金鯉迷局，更識破了屠城計畫，最終查清了真相，成功營救了聖人，亦保衛了長安城百姓。

programme.title: 降龍神掌蘇乞兒2 / Master So Dragon Subduing Palms 2
programme.desc: 大清年間，偏遠的臨江縣有兩名縣令接連被大蟒蛇咬死，百姓人心惶惶。侍衛蘇乞兒和鐵橋三奉命前往臨江縣調查此案。兩人發現當地毒品極樂丸極為盛行，而在調查當中鐵橋三與蘇乞兒也因極樂丸陷入困境。在逆境面前他們不甘屈服，憑著正義的信念，最終將幕後黑手繩之於法。

programme.title: 72小時黃金行動 / 72 Hour Golden Operation
programme.desc: 普光市內有一羣犯罪團夥“門徒”無惡不作，參與多宗販毒走私傷人案件。一天公安局接到門徒內部人員詠琳的舉報，局長找來打黑大隊長唐飛帶領警員對門徒進行深入的調查。他們要利用黃金72小時對門徒展開一次性的肅清行動，找出操控門徒團夥的核心成員，好讓普光市回復光明。

programme.title: 趙子龍 / Zhao Zi Long
programme.desc: 趙子龍在常山歸隱七年後，因戰亂變故流落到鄴城與劉備及趙雲重逢。趙子龍終究被劉備的仁義所折服，在劉備與眾人的鼓勵及殘酷現實的鞭策之下，逐漸找回自我與理想，再次號召眾兄弟並肩作戰，最終在長阪坡大敗敵軍，成為獨當一面的漢室大將。

programme.title: 大漠江湖 / Desert Legend
programme.desc: 年青鐵匠呂三思偶遇自己崇拜的大俠百裡無憂。他幫助大俠押送西廠走狗何清纓，但何卻對他說了另一個版本的故事，說她是被西廠迫害，而百裡才是出賣義士的走狗！事情越來越可疑，何不一定是走狗，而百裡也可能不是大俠。忠姦難辨，最終呂三思會選擇相信誰?

programme.title: 了不起的高二八班 / Seventeen and a Half Years Old
programme.desc: 張君佳是一名高中學生，為了接近校花黃巧姍，他想拍一部微電影，讓黃巧姍主演。藝術節快要到來，他決定組織同學們拍一部校園喪屍片，拍攝期間，眾人幾經波折，劇組更瀕臨於崩潰邊沿。然而友情、親情和愛情交織成的共同經歷，讓大家重新定義了青春，收穫了友情與成長！

programme.title: 獵殺無人區 / Hunting No Man's Land
programme.desc: 在無人區的荒野裡正發生著一場驚險的生死追蹤。少年堇言意外拍下了盜獵者襲擊警方的場面，不幸被歹徒發現後擊傷了堇。他忍耐著疼痛一路逃走，其後這幫人還挾持堇的姐姐樸雨。兩姐弟在無人區裡奮力逃走，憑藉著堅強意志，誓要逃離歹徒魔掌，將他們繩之於法。

programme.title: 奇門暗刃 / Strange Door and Dark Blade
programme.desc: 宋遼太平時期，原本是秘密組織“鳳火軍”培養的特工唐紫煙被安插在京都皇城司任職。正當唐紫煙想悄悄退出，與丈夫過上平靜的餘生時，丈夫卻被鳳凰火軍帶走來威脅唐接受新任務，刺殺來訪的北朝特使皇太弟。唐決心脫離組織，便連同皇太弟攜手打敗鳳火軍，還京城太平。

programme.title: 精武陳真 / Fist of Legend
programme.desc: 為了取長補短，陳真遠赴日本學習工業技術。留學期間，陳真與擅長形意拳的武術家薛自立一起，為了捍衛中國人民的尊嚴，他們勇敢面對日本軍部官員的比武挑戰。一場中國功夫大師與日本武士的較量正式上演，比武場上陳真展現了中國功夫“深藏不露”的武術內涵。

programme.title: 鬥士 / Fighter
programme.desc: 少男曾為獲得格鬥冠軍的哥哥少北為驕傲，以為有哥哥在便能永遠保護自己，可以像少年時一樣無憂無慮。最終哥哥在衝刺世界格鬥冠軍擂臺上身受重傷意外身亡。格鬥公司創辦人丹姐訓練少男幫助他復仇，而少男亦替少北贏回遺願，向世界證明黃種人可以屹立於世界。

programme.title: 新道師爺 / Demon Catcher
programme.desc: 民國時期，一代奇人關師爺行走江湖，巧遇狐妖鬧事。關師爺與狐妖鬥法，過程中認識了逢賭必輸的葉飛。此事過後，關師爺又巧妙化解了一樁青樓恩怨，為死去的冤者伸冤，卻再次與怪事纏身的葉飛相遇。之後二人攜手與妖怪及邪靈鬥智鬥勇，成功地降魔伏妖。

programme.title: 掃毒行動 / Anti Drug Campaign
programme.desc: 毒梟塚虎在十五年前派人追殺梅姨，當時林郎與林峰親眼目睹母親梅姨被殺害，為躲避殺手追殺，郎與峰分頭走散，但郎之後音訊全無，而峰成為緝毒員警。在中國邊境滇市的掃毒行動中，峰發現毒梟郎哥的母親也是被塚虎殺害，那郎哥是否就是林郎？緝毒隊與毒梟們的拼鬥又會如何收場？

programme.title: 狄仁傑之雷火玄龍 / Dee Renjie Thunder Fire XuanLong
programme.desc: 剛建成的洛陽宮夜裡被一條神龍縱火焚燒，木匠不是死就是失蹤。狄仁傑破格升任大理寺少卿查案，卻遭神秘勢力阻撓。他憑線索及隱士李先生的指點找到了關鍵人物宮少爺，也在紅顏知己柳月如協助下摧毀了機關基地。關鍵時刻，狄仁傑擊敗雷火玄龍，誓要還原事件真相。

programme.title: 嶗山道士 / Laoshan Taoist
programme.desc: 一心想要去學習嶗山道法的少年王生，終獲高人指點，學成歸家，之後卻把師父“不可生邪念”的教誨丟在腦後，學了點法術便打算用來行竊。隅然王解開了自己身世之謎，又經過幾番歷練才終於開悟，決定用屬於自己的方式來對抗邪魔外道。

programme.title: 無雙花木蘭 / Unparalleled Mulan
programme.desc: 北魏時期柔然軍入侵邊境，花木蘭為老父出徵，女扮男裝入伍來到邊關要塞常平倉。木蘭在戰場上奮勇殺敵，屢建戰功，取得多次勝利。正當眾人歡慶之際，敵人將數量足有百萬隻老鼠投入城中，趁亂攻城，令他們受到重創。為了保衛百姓安全，木蘭不惜以生命為代價，奮力死守常平倉。

programme.title: 狄仁傑探案 / Detection of Di Renjie
programme.desc: 武則天時期，京城長安接連發生了好幾次離奇死亡案件，因為死因不明，以致忠烈祠飛天壁畫顯靈殺人的謠言愈演愈烈，百姓紛紛認為是天降不祥，人心惶惶。在地方屢破奇案的狄仁傑奉命調查此案，最終不僅破除了謠言，也通過多方排查後讓案情真相大白，找出了真正的兇手。

programme.title: 中華英雄之風雲再起 / A Man Called Hero
programme.desc: 金傲為保護中華傲決與無敵大戰，在生命垂危的時候將中華傲決傳授給華英雄。然而擁有“天煞孤星”命格的華英雄失去了父母及妻子，離開了兒女，潛心修煉二十年卻始終無法參悟中華傲決。最終，華為了所有中國人要與無敵對決。他能否在最後關頭頓悟中華傲決，擊敗無敵?

programme.title: 黃河巨蛇事件 / Yellow River Serpent
programme.desc: 黃河邊的一個小村落，有一口浮棺出現後，村中怪事頻發。撈屍人趙家帶人下水查探，但只有家主一人生還。多年後浮棺再現，千年巨蛇亦浮出水面，趙家後代趙佰用祖傳秘術來對付巨蛇。另外陳家因盜墓受到詛咒，壽命很短，傳聞需找到浮棺才能破咒。於是趙陳兩家便一同踏上尋棺戰蛇之路。

programme.title: 禦龍修仙傳3上古戰場 / Dragon Sword-Ancient Battlefield
programme.desc: 傅炎為了拯救瀕臨死亡的藍墨伊，毅然前往上古戰場神佑之地，尋找神炎來救藍。上古戰場分三層，他們剛從外層降服了守護獸赤墨玄蛟時，便遇到蒼岩宗宗主蒼石靈君。然而傅及石二人要爭奪對方的半張藏寶圖，在一番激戰後二人終於和解，願意分享地圖，共同前往尋找寶藏及神炎。

programme.title: 花悸 / The Revenge of Plant
programme.desc: 青山大學著名植物學教授霍玉春研發出一種可以讓植物與動物DNA相結合的新病毒。此時女學生羅柯向教授的助教鄭問表白，兩人墜入愛河之際，病毒突然在學校中爆發，柯不幸受感染被隔離。為了拯救學校及柯，鄭問找到教授的秘密實驗室，卻從中發現教授及柯二人不為人知的秘密。

programme.title: 少林降魔 / Vanquishing the Demons
programme.desc: 一個佛與魔較量的故事。為阻止上古妖魔羅剎降世，將世間顛覆成萬劫不復的寒冰煉獄，少林寺弟子慧海踏上了尋找降龍羅漢之旅。青梅竹馬的上官靈素始終陪伴守護慧海，不畏困難，幫助慧海破除心魔，參透少林精神，最終憑藉著少林子弟的力量，破除幻境道，還蒼生太平！

programme.title: 齊天大聖 / Qi Tian Da Sheng
programme.desc: 孫悟空被壓五指山下四百年時，碰巧被阿一所救。而龍太子得知悟空已逃出，要報當年東海龍宮被毀之仇，便利用悟空昔日好友蛟魔王刺殺悟空，但刺殺失敗，不過阿一被俘虜。為了救阿一，悟空與龍太子從海裡打到南天門。最終悟空被感化，回到五指山繼續修行，等待他的有緣人。

programme.title: 大海怪 / The Sea Monster
programme.desc: 明朝末年，大明水師軍官林嘯為了阻止東瀛倭寇得到“神機武庫”，及要找回失蹤的戰友陸老大，而接受了水師參將向吉的徵召，踏上兇險的尋寶之路。航行中，神秘海怪族羣與倭寇均同時盯上了林的船。他必須與同伴合力與倭寇以及巨型海怪鬥智鬥勇，攜手完成艱鉅的任務。

programme.title: 張三豐 / The Tai Chi Master
programme.desc: 南宋末年，國家陷入內憂外患的局面。狄族聯合魔教，妄想踏平中原稱霸江湖，危難之際，無極派大弟子張君寶又名張三豐挺身而出，協助朝廷擊退敵軍，卻不料師門慘遭魔教血洗，死傷慘重。為了振興門派，保衛家園，張毅然踏上了剷除魔教之路，在過程中卻又被捲入一場更大的陰謀。

programme.title: 沙海怪獸 / Desert Monster
programme.desc: 民國初年，生物研究所得知在沙海有異變生物，於是派出探索小隊前往調查，但前去的隊員幾乎全部被滅，剩下劉夢西和夏萱帶著生物樣本逃離，過程非常危險，幸得獲沙丘鎮柳纓所救。原來沙漠出現異獸，居民被迫在地底生活，最終為求生存，沙漠青年們被迫與變異獸展開了一場生死搏鬥。

programme.title: 陳情令之生魂 / The Living Dead
programme.desc: 以前的扶風城晚上花燈特別閃耀，尤如白天，然而現在卻被黑暗籠罩，更流傳著“點燈殺人”的傳說，以致城中百姓晚上也不敢點燈。溫寧到城後，發現了很多反常之處，後來更遇到藍氏子弟藍思追，倆人為了還百姓一個太平安寧，攜手合作，要擒住不斷殺人的幕後真兇 。

programme.title: 狙擊之王 / The Sniper
programme.desc: 在剿滅東南亞最大的犯罪組織救世會時，金泰在任務中誤殺了自己的師傅金銘。泰極度自責，默然離開特工組織。然而消失多年的救世會再次出現，泰更得知組織的頭目竟是死而復生的銘，令他一蹶不振，直到一個男孩的出現，讓泰再次拿起塵封已久的狙擊槍，前去了斷與師傅的恩怨情仇。

programme.title: 狄仁傑之幽兵借路 / Di Renjie Secret Soldier Borrows
programme.desc: 武週時期，禦史中丞胡顯德一家被殺，武則天派狄仁傑前往調查。狄調查發現，原本老實本分的胡離奇般參與了一場大案，此案可能是一宗案中案。在查案過程中，狄不斷遇見各種詭異事件，更有陰兵索命的傳言，案件一籌莫展。狄向來不相信鬼神論，當他深入調查時，發現了背後的重大玄機。

programme.title: 龍棺古墓：西夏狼王 / Long Guan Gu Mu
programme.desc: 上世紀10年代初，以劉錦州為首的“生旦淨醜”四位戲子，為了營救在西夏狼王墓失蹤的恩師袁震，不得不踏上兇險萬分的探墓尋人之旅。在墓穴中一行人經歷了種種危機和生離死別，在過程中發現了古墓的神秘寶物及師父不為人知的秘密。

programme.title: 東遊傳 / Journey of East
programme.desc: 唐德宗元年，道士預言黑蛟即將面世危害百姓。這日呂姓書生坐船東渡去找白瑛退婚，到達後發現白的父親失蹤，白也被傀儡化，而他亦遭到襲擊。書生逃脫後，遇到太白金星被告知他是被打入凡間的呂洞賓，前世今生黑蛟都是他的劫難，而他與白瑛也有著情緣，一切都是他必需面對的歷練。

programme.title: 龍虎制霸 / The Mob
programme.desc: 1928年的上海灘，新生勢力龍德商會為擴大地盤與老牌勢力通明堂產生利益衝突，雙方摩擦不斷。通明堂小少爺週放，因父親被殺要為父報仇，帶領眾人對決龍德商會，卻在復仇過程中與商會二把手林海惺惺相惜。然而二人命定是敵對的，冥冥之中注定有一場激烈的對決。

programme.title: 聊齋古卷：蘭若之境 / The Ghost Story: Love Redemption
programme.desc: 蒲松齡在寫故事時無意打開了生老病三道門的封印，放出了巨樹之妖黑山的分身。天女發現黑山，與其大打出手，不幸身形被滅，要借助蒲的妻子甄娘化為人形。打鬥中她們被黑山所困，天女告知蒲若要救出甄娘，他得要感動三門妖靈。為挽救妻子及蒼生，他奮力走上闖關之路。

programme.title: Live and Die in East LA
programme.desc: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. To save his sister from prison, Attila becomes a drug courier, igniting a gang war that forces a tragic choice.

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Filipino actor, model and swimmer Enchong Dee and his celebrity friend Ria, to explore the highs and lows of Hong Kong. They are eager to push their boundaries in this thrilling new adventure.

programme.title: Bride with the White Hair
programme.desc: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

programme.title: Agent of Death
programme.desc: After undergoing a secret government experiment, CIA operative Tara gains the ability to shapeshift into anyone through DNA transformation, making her the ultimate infiltrator. When her father is murdered and evidence points to her own agency, she is forced to go rogue. Now, she must stop stolen uranium from triggering a global nuclear catastrophe.

programme.title: Zhong Kui Exorcism
programme.desc: After demons massacre his hometown and kill his loved ones, young Zhong Kui sets out for revenge. Along the way, he meets a half-demon princess and uncovers a sinister plot behind his former lover's mysterious resurrection. Wielding the Sacred Demon-Slaying Sword, he battles evil and becomes the legendary Demon Queller Zhong Kui.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Robot Apocalypse
programme.desc: When expert hacker Tara tries to stop a powerful and sentient A.I. from taking over the world's military, the A.I. marks her as a terrorist who must be exterminated…

programme.title: Extreme Ends
programme.desc: Extreme Ends is an action-adventure reality show featuring four celebrities and their special guests experiencing the diversity of Hong Kong! Join Indonesian famous models Patricia and Chika as they explore the city's hidden gems and vibrant scenes, immersing themselves in amazing contrasts and trendy vibes.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: To combat the greenhouse effect, scientist Yan Xin attempts to plant newly developed super rubber seeds on a remote island, hoping to transform it into a thriving new land. Yan Xin's ex-husband decides to accompany her on this perilous journey. As conflicts arise, they encounter the local drug cartel, and a fatal battle is about to begin.

programme.title: Fong Sai-Yuk, Return of Heroes
programme.desc: After Fong Sai-Yuk’s adoptive father is murdered by traitors of the Red Flower Society, he vows to hunt them down and avenge his death. Driven by grief and loyalty, he rises against the conspirators in a ruthless fight for justice.

programme.title: The Ultimate BROcation
programme.desc: A hilarious reality show about four famous male celebrities from different countries on an all-expenses-paid fantasy vacation in Hong Kong, tailor-made for the “bros”!

programme.title: Monkey Twins
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of his lover, Neua learns Monkey Muay Thai and vows to avenge her death. His lover’s sister, who practises Chinese Kung Fu, initially suspects Neua of being responsible, but later discovers that her sister was killed by an organised crime ring. Together, they join forces to uphold justice and seek vengeance.

The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: Live and Die in East LA
programme.desc: After treating a boy injured in a hit-and-run, ER doctor Attila is drawn into East L.A.’s underworld conflict. The boy is the son of a crime lord, and the “accident” was gang revenge. programme.title: Extreme Ends

programme.title: Bride with the White Hair
programme.desc: Cult leader Yu Luo Sha slays four sect leaders. Zhuo Yi Hang confronts her but falls in love. When he marries another, her hair turns white, and she vows eternal vengeance.

While Feng begins a new life, the triad finds him and hires a top boxer to beat him. As Feng suddenly regains his memory in the process, he vows to take down the triad.

programme.title: Iron Squad W
programme.desc: The fourth season of this Korean military survival show will determine the most elite female soldier. Witness how they battle to the end in front of six celebrity hosts!

programme.title: Fierce Cop

programme.desc: Bodyguard Long Wei has post‐traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. programme.title: Hide & Seek
programme.desc: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. programme.title: Behave

programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: As a young mother grapples with her daughter's mysterious disappearance, a series of eerie events unfold. These events could be linked to the vengeful ghosts of a tragic accident that happened 20 years ago...

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. programme.title: Never Leave
programme.desc: Strange incidents keep happening in Lin Yue's house after a car accident: her sister cannot see the images of her family members in the mirror; her father is peeping at night; and there is the sound of marbles from the attic every day at dawn. Following the sound to the attic, Lin Yue finds her own death portrait as she opens the door...

programme.title: Fengmen Village Horror
programme.desc: A remote Jiangnan village plagued by mysterious deaths becomes known as the cursed ghost village Fengmen. Determined to uncover the truth, journalist Li Mu joins forces with officer Wan Feng to investigate the chilling incidents. As fear spreads among the villagers, the two risk their lives to expose the dark secrets behind Fengmen.

programme.title: Mama Ghost
programme.desc: In a coastal town, a forbidden romance sparks between Rico and Sisca, and their love unleashes a malevolent spirit. As chilling deaths plague the town, past secrets are being unraveled and the town is possessed by evil and fear. Rico must defy destiny and fight against the evil spirit to save his loved one.

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. As they dive deeper, the property's dark secrets ensnare them in a hellish labyrinth which they must escape before dawn.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Three KOLs embark on a live-streaming trip to a remote island. However, they are deceived by a mysterious old woman who traps them, intending to find brides for her disabled grandsons. As they realise they have been captured, they must race against time to escape this nightmare island.

programme.title: White
programme.desc: As a boy, Xie Yi Zhong performed a spirit-summoning ritual and accidentally invoked Bai Wu Chang, the White Reaper, triggering a tragedy. Years later, he returns home to find his hometown plagued by eerie events and his loved ones' lives at stake. Will he dare summon the spirit again to confront the evil forces?

programme.title: The Ones You Didn't Burn
programme.desc: After their father's death, Nathan and his sister return to their family home to prepare it for sale. While there, Nathan discovers that the land was stolen from the ancestors of two women accused of witchcraft. As he delves deeper, he uncovers an occult conspiracy linked to their father's death which now threatens them both.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A taxi driver who is constantly judging others by his own standards, also reads into their every move and sets out to help ‘victims’ in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he goes about setting things right for her, even resorting to turning himself into a cold-blooded serial killer…

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer joins a tour to explore the renowned windmills of the Netherlands. As their tour coach breaks down on the way, they seek refuge in a creepy shed near a sinister windmill with a dark history. When some tour members suddenly disappear, Jennifer discovers a shared secret among them, linking their fates in a chilling revelation.

programme.title: Anak Perjanjian Syaitan 2
programme.desc: Haunted since childhood, orphan Azlinda believes her torment stems from her parents' dark history. Her friends Zurina, Wati, and Ustaz join forces to end her suffering, but a malevolent demon interrupts their efforts. Will Azlinda succeed in severing the cursed ties that bind her, or is she destined to remain trapped in darkness forever?

programme.title: Mid-night Two
programme.desc: Yi Cheng and his friends venture into a haunted mountain that hides an ancient corpse and an eternal ghostly flame. No one who enters the mountain ever returns and at 2:30 AM, Yi Cheng’s friends vanish one by one. While searching for them in the eerie forest, Yi Cheng enters a realm of infinite reincarnation, facing a series of terrifying events…

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: Global warming has awakened a malevolent spore from beneath an ancient ice field, unleashing a horrific plague that ravages humanity. Fleeing the chaos, Meadow takes refuge in an abandoned cabin. Together with other strangers, she fights to survive as some succumb to the plague, transforming into ravenous hunters who now stalk the living.

programme.title: Detective Dee's Seven Deadly Sin
programme.desc: Detective Dee becomes embroiled in a series of murders that shake the Tang Empire. The killer invokes the "Seven Deadly Sins" to justify a twisted sense of justice. In his relentless pursuit of the truth, Detective Dee uncovers the mask of false righteousness and exposes the darkness hidden beneath.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: After a car accident erases his memory, Wang Ren Jie takes a job as a night guard. When the clock strikes midnight, he reports for duty at an abandoned building — only to find three lost souls awaiting him, and unravels a revenge plot at the same time. Is this fate or a curse cast by vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: Olivia, an outstanding vampire romance novelist, longs to encounter a real vampire. Her wish comes true when Luke turns up at her remote snowbound cabin seeking for help. However, her dream transforms into a chilling nightmare on Christmas Eve when Luke's vampire companions track him down...

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a camping trip inside a supposedly haunted forest despite warning not to do so. As night falls and camps are set, the complicated relationships of lust and love between them are exposed, triggering a series of paranormal events that punishes them. When dawn breaks, who will get out of the forest alive?

programme.title: Sinister - The Virtual Game
programme.desc: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death; while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him; three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: A struggling writer retreats to his childhood home to finish a novel and save his career. There, he uncovers the final manuscript left behind by his father, a famous writer who died mysteriously years earlier. Realizing the work is beyond his own talent, he decides to plagiarize it, unleashing horrifying supernatural events.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter —the sole witness— mysteriously disappears. For decades, the haunting of the Kang house on Green Wood Lane lingers. As the truth behind the tragedy unfolds, motives of revenge and death intertwine in this chilling mystery.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A woman in hospital accidentally discovers her husband’s affair. On the verge of breakdown, she begins to encounter a “stranger” who claims to also be a victim of the affair. Is this entity a figment of her imagination or a vengeful spirit? As she struggles to control her thoughts and actions, can she stop herself from hurting those around her?

programme.title: An Unquiet Grave
programme.desc: A year after Jamie's wife tragically died in a car accident, he persuades her sister, Ava, to accompany him to the accident site to perform a peculiar ritual. As the night progresses, it becomes evident that Jamie harbours sinister motives.

programme.title: Rooftop
programme.desc: A group of friends invites Paul to a secret party on their campus rooftop. When a prank accidentally kills Paul, the friends cover up the incident and promised never to disclose it. Paul vows to take revenge by becoming a vicious ghost to haunt them into taking responsibility for their actions.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Hide & Seek
programme.desc: Thirteen years after an explosion in an abandoned building killed their friend Noo Aon, Tong and his group return to the site—now their university campus. When a girl who looks exactly like Noo Aon appears, a childhood game turns into a lethal ritual. One by one, the friends are hunted by a vengeful spirit determined to settle a long-overdue score.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: A school girl joins two internet content creators in a horror video project filmed in an old building behind their school. The trio encounters a bullying gang and as events unfold, it becomes clear that the girl holds a personal grudge against the gang and is blinded by hatred to exercise justice, even if it means sacrificing the innocents…

programme.title: Circle of Bones
programme.desc: While investigating a series of cult ritual massacres, Philippine police rescue the sole survivor on Bohol Island, who is a former FBI agent living under a false identity. As the investigation deepens, her accounts of ancient prophecies, demonic possession and bloody rituals draw everyone into a terrifying mystery where reality blurs.

programme.title: Behave
programme.desc: Following the death of their friend, a group of young adults travels to a villa on the outskirts of London that contains a deep mystery. As unsettling events escalate during their luxurious stay, they must unravel the villa’s dark secrets.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Model Family
programme.desc: A single-parent family (Yu Xiang and Tong Tong) moves into a new neighbourhood where everyone’s life seems perfect. However, while things may look rosy on the outside, dark secrets and horror raid each family from the inside, and nothing really are as they seem.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks.
